PEOPLE_NOTE: Demo data. Roles, responsibilities and mandate are defined per role in the Roles and Responsibilities register. Counts are the number of open corrective actions and nonconformity actions each person holds.

PEOPLE.name: Alex Morgan
PEOPLE.responsibilities: Implements and maintains the ISMS, EMS and QMS; runs risk assessments, internal audits and corrective actions; owns incident management; liaises with the certification body and regulators.
PEOPLE.mandate: Authority to enforce compliance measures and to stop processes in the event of nonconformities or security risks.
PEOPLE.note: Took the role over in 2026 and inherited most of the open audit actions.

PEOPLE.name: Priya Shah

PEOPLE.mandate: Authority to approve or reject suppliers and to request compliance evidence.

PEOPLE.name: Lena Fischer
